# Brycen Wood

> Business automation consultant who builds custom operating systems for small
> businesses using Claude Code. Non-technical founder. No coding experience.
> Built 80+ automations for his own vehicle wrap company (Summit Wraps --
> $52K to $300K revenue growth). Now offers the same build service to other
> businesses. Fixed-scope: 60-min interview, custom plan in 72 hours,
> 2-week build, full handoff.

## Services
- [Custom Business Build](https://www.brycenwood.com/services/custom-build/) - Full operating system build: CRM, email, SEO, dashboards, content pipelines. Starting at $3,500.
- [Monthly AI Retainer](https://www.brycenwood.com/services/retainer/) - Ongoing support, new features, optimization. $2,000/month.
- [How It Works](https://www.brycenwood.com/process/) - 60-min interview, 72-hour plan, 2-week build, full handoff.
- [Pricing](https://www.brycenwood.com/pricing/) - Transparent pricing: $3,500 (founder), $7,500 (standard), $15,000+ (enterprise).
